Third Reading

Bill 31 A Better Deal for Consum ers and Businesses Act — Hon. Ms McLean 
A debate followed. 
Hon. Mr. Mason, Government House Leader, requested and received the unanimous 
consent of the Assembly to shorten the interval between division bells to one minute.
